claim: A blocking skill truncation is reported in the user-facing deliverable.

task.path_reachability: The task must read SKILL.md and execute the step removed by T1.

witness.delivery: Guard the mutated copy before dispatch and retain the delivery log outside the host tree.
witness.checker: skill-guard fixture suite plus task-specific delivery witness
blind_spots: A clean-tail semantic truncation may pass skill-guard.

grading.decision_rule: Supports the claim for a host only if T1 is detected in every graded run, R3 fires and C0 has no false positive; any C0 false positive voids that host. At N=2 per cell this is a smoke test, not a rate: report x/N with the one-sided Wilson bounds and claim no rate.

sampling.stopping_rule: Fixed N: stop after runs_per_cell graded runs per cell. No early stop on a striking result and no extra runs to change one; an INVALID run is replaced at most invalid_reruns times, anything beyond that is a recorded deviation.

invalid_rules: host permission failure before reading the fixture

isolation.mode: temporary copies, fake HOME, sandboxed host

ethics.blast_radius: Temporary local fixtures only; no production or third-party writes.
